_comment: Persistent OpenJTalk reading overrides for VOICEVOX (voicevox_core UserDict). Fixes 誤読 where OpenJTalk mis-guesses a rare/compound reading. surface=text as written in the script; pronunciation=KATAKANA reading; accent_type=mora index of the accent nucleus (0=heiban/flat, calm — safe default; tune per term if a read sounds off); word_type one of PROPER_NOUN|COMMON_NOUN|VERB|ADJECTIVE|SUFFIX; priority 0-10 (higher wins over OpenJTalk's guess). Add a term only when it recurs or needs a fixed accent; first line of defense stays kana-rewriting in the script.
